description: This 2015 BMW M4 Convertible is finished in Black Sapphire Metallic over a Sakhir Orange interior. Power is provided by a twin-turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-6 paired with a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Equipment includes the Executive and Lighting packages, 19-inch Style 437M wheels, an Adaptive M suspension, heated front seats, a Harman Kardon sound system, and a rearview camera. Modifications reported by the seller are limited to a carbon fiber wrap on the lower front bumper trim. The seller is representing this M4 on behalf of the third owner, who reportedly purchased it in November 2024.
conditionExterior: Curb rash on wheels. Some wear on seats and interior trim.
